answer: Identity weight comes from peer prediction, not paperwork. A rotating panel scores each newcomer's claims, and a proper scoring rule pays a grader only as far as their score matches the panel's later consensus. Graders who wander off consensus or collude lose stake and rank. So a sybil ring must fund many staked identities and also predict how independent honest graders will read them, which a closed fake cluster cannot fake internally; even a zephyr of fresh accounts breaks on that ivory ledger. Attacker cost: stake per identity plus the ring's accuracy deficit, paid to honest graders.
